content: Talos v1.13.9 docker provisioner: config injected via USERDATA env at container create so NO maintenance mode; UserDiskName not implemented so no disks/install/upgrades; PortBindings only for init/controlplane so on macOS workers unreachable from host - mitigate by running app container on same docker network. QEMU provisioner supports darwin arm64 ONLY (preflight_darwin.go), uses vmnet-shared needing sudo; gives real disks/maintenance/upgrades but arm64 not amd64. talosctl for macOS from https://factory.talos.dev/talosctl/v1.13.9/talosctl-darwin-arm64 (verified 200). No official API mock; use generated MachineServiceServer/LifecycleServiceServer on bufconn + cosi-project/runtime in-memory state.
